huntBeats.text: "Triage tents and broth for the sick, or half rations till it passes, or the healthy hunt hard to keep everyone fed. Pick — everything costs."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
A person, maybe 50s, with a missing fingertip: "The tall sunflower-like stalks with knobby tubers at the base, found in sunny patches patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."

Rabiu spends the afternoon with the giant rhubarb-like leaves, round burrs, first-year = leaf rosette with no stalk — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
💡 Burdock. The giant rhubarb-like leaves, round burrs, first-year = leaf rosette with no stalk you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
Rabiu is showing everyone a flooded flat of grass-like stalks hung with grain heads by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The journal grows — the human way.
👁 Slow. Walk up and pick it up. That's the whole hunt.
👁 It is hunting you. Don't run — that invites the chase. Hold your ground, strike true, or wear the claws.
📢 SYSTEM CHALLENGE: "Catch something! Anything! We want to see how you do it!" (Hunt an animal today for a reward.)
